card.name: Small linking words in conditional clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as if, when, the, at or is that open a conditional or qualifying phrase in label warnings. They come right after a comma or a clinical statement, as in 'if clinically indicated' or 'when indicated'.

modes.label: Conditional if/when
modes.description: The word if or when after a comma, introducing a qualifier such as 'clinically indicated' or 'possible'.
modes.example: consider discontinuation of EMBLAVEO,<< if>> clinically indicated, and monitor the patient for

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: The, at or is inside a clause that qualifies a recommendation or risk.
modes.example: Fetal testing may be appropriate, based on<< the>> week of pregnancy.

card.plain: It fires on short linking words that start a qualifier such as 'if indicated' in warning text.
